As part of a purpose-driven organisation, you'll be working in a collaborative and values-led environment where your work directly contributes to enriching lives and strengthening communities. 

Your opportunity

From architectural security reviews to vulnerability management and data protection initiatives,you'llensure robust security frameworks that protect our mission.

With ownership, you will:

Oversee vulnerability management and risk mitigation programs

Engage senior stakeholders and provide compliance reporting

What you'll bring

You are a strategic leader with deepexpertisein cyber security controls,governanceand risk management. You bring strong analytical skills, excellentcommunicationand the ability to translate complex security concepts into actionable strategies.

You will also need:

Tertiary qualification in IT, Cyber Security or Risk Management

Proven experience in cyber security, controls assurance and risk governance

Familiarity withCyber Security Frameworks such as SCF(preferred), NIST and ISO 27001

Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement skills

result.description:
This thriving clinic in the leafy suburb of Sherwood, QLD, is currently seeking a motivated and forward-thinking General Practitioner to join its well-established team. Operating as a high-demand mixed-billing practice, the facility offers a sophisticated environment equipped with modern consulting rooms and dedicated procedure spaces. The incoming doctor will inherit an established patient base, ensuring a seamless transition and immediate clinical volume within a community that values high-quality, patient-centered care. 

 The practice prides itself on a collaborative and multidisciplinary team composition designed to minimize burnout and maximize clinical efficiency. Practitioners are supported by a highly experienced nursing team and a proactive administrative department, with dedicated assistance available for Chronic Disease Management (CDM) and complex care planning. For those with a clinical niche, there is a significant opportunity to integrate special interests—particularly in skin cancer medicine—into their daily practice, supported by the necessary equipment for comprehensive checks and procedures. 

 Recognizing the importance of professional fulfillment and longevity, the clinic offers a unique pathway toward partnership and profit-sharing. This opportunity is ideally suited for an entrepreneurial-minded GP who wishes to move beyond standard contractor work and take an active role in leadership and business development. Clinical autonomy is a cornerstone of the practice philosophy, allowing doctors the freedom to practice medicine their way while receiving full support for Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and opportunities to engage in registrar supervision for those passionate about medical education. 

 Work-life balance is prioritized through flexible working arrangements, allowing the practitioner to tailor their schedule to suit personal commitments. Located in the heart of Sherwood, the role offers exceptional lifestyle benefits, including proximity to prestigious schools, vibrant cafes, and the serene Brisbane River. With a competitive offer of 70% of billings and a clear trajectory toward ownership, this position represents a premier opportunity for a GP looking to build, lead, and share in the long-term success of a growing medical landmark.   Apply Now
